Supervisor · from your Mac or phone

Stop checking tabs.
Start deciding.

Supervisor groups supported Codex, Claude Code, Conductor, and other coding conversations by project. It shows what is working, what is blocked, what is waiting on checks, and the questions that need you.

Read the question with the thread, pull request, and verification evidence beside it. Observe first. Propose a reply when you choose. Auto is an explicit, bounded setting — discovery never sends a message or runs an action.

The project thesis

Three ideas that make
a runtime useful.

Read the full whitepaper ↗
01

Directional Adaptive Scrutiny

Before an event becomes an action, the runtime can decide whether to act, ask, watch, ignore, or bring in a specialist. Permissions and evidence shape that decision.

Example A failed check becomes a question with its PR and log, not an unexplained automated change.

02

Tiered Memory

Short-term context, recurring patterns, and durable knowledge have different lifetimes. A correction can become a reviewed preference instead of disappearing at the end of a chat.

Example “Keep release notes brief” can be saved, recalled, and corrected from Memory.

03

Propagation

Useful context can move between the runtime, skills, devices, and specialists with an inspectable record. You choose which tools and nodes receive it.

Example A watched project update can reach a paired phone without giving the phone blanket access to the Mac.

Start on the host you control

Install the runtime.
Get one result.

OpenAGI keeps conversations, memory, tasks, and configuration on the host you choose. Pair a phone or another node later.

⌘macOS · v0.0.83

Download the Mac app

DMG → Applications → launch. Native menu bar app, bundled runtime, updates, and optional screen/computer access.

Download OpenAGI-0.0.83.dmg ↗ ⊞Windows x64 · v0.0.83

Download the portable ZIP

Extract the whole archive and run Start-OpenAGI.cmd. No Node or Git needed for the published bundle.

Download Windows x64 ↗ ⌁Linux x64 / arm64 · v0.0.83

Download or use Docker

Use the portable tarball, the inspected installer, or Docker. Raspberry Pi needs a compatible 64-bit arm64 OS.

docker run ghcr.io/spshulem/openagi:<version>Download Linux x64 ↗ $Source · Docker · all paths

Follow the install guide

Source installs use Node.js 22+. The guide covers Docker, model setup, updates, state, Windows PowerShell, and recovery.

First useful task · two minutes

Give it one thing to take off your plate.

  1. Connect & verifyChoose a cloud provider, local OpenAI-compatible server, or native Apple model on supported Mac/iPhone builds.
  2. Ask for a real resultDraft a three-item brief, save a non-sensitive preference, or show one project status.
  3. Choose what comes nextKeep it local, add a skill, pair a phone, or connect an integration later in Settings.

Current release checked 21 Nov 2026: v0.0.83 publishes the Mac DMG, Windows x64 ZIP, Linux x64 tarball, Linux arm64 tarball, and SHA-256 files on GitHub. The all-platform release page is the download index.

Make it yours

Open where it matters.
Bounded where it counts.

Configure the parts that shape behavior instead of accepting a black box.

Skills

Turn a routine into a reviewed capability.

Skills are inspectable Markdown with explicit tools and optional replay. Accept suggestions; they do not silently become actions.

Skills in the README ↗
MCP

Connect tools one at a time.

MCP servers become first-class tools after you configure and authorize them. Keep account keys in Settings.

MCP documentation ↗
Models

Use cloud or local inference.

Anthropic, OpenAI, ChatGPT plan, Ollama, LM Studio, and the native Apple path are separate choices. Verify a real response first.

Model setup ↗
Permissions

Observe, propose, or allow a bounded action.

Screen access, computer use, account connections, and Supervisor sends are opt-in. Approvals remain durable and reviewable.

Control boundaries ↗
